fields.value: RaPID selection sequencing data SARS-CoV-2 spike

dsDescriptionValue.value: Raw sequencing data files from Illumina MiSeq run of enriched libraries from RaPID selections against SARS-CoV-2 spike (and further sub-selections against S1B domain, S1 domain, and SARS-CoV spike 'sars1') with 15mer random macrocyclic peptides initiated with chloroacetyl D- or L-tyrosine (in two separate selections).
